goals.name: 2027 Open Enrollment
goals.assessment: 10/12: The carrier renewal came in with a 32.6% benefit cost increase, now going to underwriting review. Anne believes a large share of enrolled employees don't actually work the hours to qualify (example: a mover hired full-time 6/30 averaging 12.5 hrs/week and enrolled employee-only). Jalissa is rerunning the branch enrollment sheet with every enrolled employee's average weekly hours by measurement period (initial vs. standard), due 10/19. Anne meets Cali on renewal strategy Tue 10/13 at noon (also on the agenda: Mutual of Omaha placed all employees in STD class one at implementation); the hours data follows for the decision with Cameron and Paul, so the plan-design call (variable-hour hiring, eligibility waiting period) is driven by the numbers. Also new: a monthly term check on the first business day after month close, with manual overrides caught within 3 days, after Jalissa's 10/11 audit found three employees still active in Mutual of Omaha after termination. 10/9: Paul asked to have the benefits strategy decided by end of next week, before the QGR. Anne parked it until the survey closes 10/14 so the voluntary benefits answers (most respondents are completing them) inform the call. 9/16: status moves yellow → green per Anne/Cameron's 1:1, though this stays blocked on Paul's benefits-gate decision per Cameron's own note — no bar text change. First real working session with Cali Beeman (Gallagher) ran 8/21 — substantive, not just a handoff call. ACA variable-hour classification strategy is taking real shape (6-month measurement period emerging as the compromise with Paul, not yet decided). Two compliance gaps surfaced and are being fixed: Einstein likely has no ERISA wrap plan document (5500s were filed as separate plans, a tell-tale sign) and likely no Section 125 pre-tax plan document — both going to ETC to draft. Also found and started fixing an ACA rehire-coding bug in Rippling (reinstated employees default to exact rehire date instead of 1st-of-month, creating false coverage-gap signals). Still no 2027 plan-year decisions locked with Cameron/Paul. 8/31: sent BMs a reminder to term verbally-terminated movers in Rippling this week, to validate the benefits file feeds ahead of the redesign recommendation. Trajectory: tracking yellow — real progress with Cali, but plan-year decisions aren't locked and Paul's read on the redesign is still pending; November bar has runway but multiple external dependencies are unresolved. 10/5: Anne sent Cali the next communication. On schedule for the November window.
